# Globalucar (global-ucars.com)

> Guangzhou Vehicle External Trade Co., Ltd — China-based exporter of new & used
> vehicles and OEM-grade auto parts, shipping FOB Guangzhou / Nansha Port to
> Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, Southeast Asia and Central Asia.
> Wholesale auto parts brand: Kingmay. Contact: ucars@global-ucars.com

## Core Resources

- [OE Part Number Reference Library](https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/): 236,000+
  verified OE part numbers for Hyundai, Kia, GM Korea (Daewoo), SsangYong and
  more — grouped by vehicle system with cross-references and fitment notes.
  Sub-libraries:
  - Engine & Fuel System: https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/engine.html
  - Cooling & Climate: https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/cooling.html
  - Electrical & Sensors: https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/electrical.html
  - Brake System: https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/brake.html
  - Transmission & Drivetrain: https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/transmission.html
  - Suspension & Steering: https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/suspension-steering.html
  - Body & Exterior: https://www.global-ucars.com/oe/body.html
- [Parts Catalog](https://www.global-ucars.com/products.html?cat=parts):
  150+ export-ready auto parts (engine, cooling, electrical, suspension).
- [New & Used Vehicle Export](https://www.global-ucars.com/products.html):
  Chinese brand vehicles (BYD, Chery, Geely, Haval, AION and others) plus
  certified pre-owned cars, FOB Guangzhou.
- [OEM Parts Lookup Tool](https://www.global-ucars.com/oem-parts-lookup.html):
  search any OE number against our catalog.
- [Services](https://www.global-ucars.com/services.html): sourcing, quality
  inspection, consolidation, customs documentation, RORO/container shipping.
- [Get a Quote](https://www.global-ucars.com/contact.html)

Buyer guides on sourcing auto parts from China and vehicle export procedures:

- [OEM vs Aftermarket Auto Parts from China](https://www.global-ucars.com/blog/oem-vs-aftermarket-auto-parts-china.html)
- [Hyundai & Kia Parts Wholesale Guides](https://www.global-ucars.com/blog.html):

  with OE numbers and FOB pricing.
- [Vehicle Export Guides](https://www.global-ucars.com/blog.html): country-by-

  including FOB Nansha pricing and import documentation.

## Facts

- OE library: 236,000+ verified part numbers; 11,000+ live reference pages.
- Parts inventory: 150+ SKUs across engine, cooling, electrical, suspension.
- Port: Guangzhou / Nansha. Incoterms: FOB. MOQ: flexible, wholesale pricing.
- Languages: English (sales support in English & Chinese).
